scientific_review: Internal pass checked amino-acid origins, shared aldoxime logic, biosynthesis vs activation, clover two-locus segregation, glucosinolate core and sulfur sources, synthetase specificity and non-protein amino acid distinctions, betalain branch logic and CYP76AD/DODA genetic evidence, comparison with anthocyanins, hypothetical versus empirical data, and all 50 answer keys. Independently recomputed 9/16 and 1/4 joint inheritance probabilities, 50% inventory gain and 25% concentration reduction, net pool 24 µmol, 2:1 absorbance ratio, 2+2 pigment mixture, 10 µM Beer–Lambert example, absorbance 2 at 1% transmittance, 30 µmol nitrogen atoms.
editorial_review: Separate internal pass benchmarked recent 6.G.03 (14,409 genuine words) against 13,552 target words, reviewed accessible progressive narrative, unique paragraphs, misconception and recall, original questions and shuffled answers, added current official MPPSC syllabus, restored dynamic navigation and diagram zoom for all figures, checked tag balance and JS compilation, all question-key mappings, labels and anchors.
deductions: Scientific: simplified pathway models and indexed-source rather than exhaustive full-text review; pedagogy: dense comparative sections; illustrations: schematic and not visually rendered; assessment: some straightforward distractors and no external exam calibration; reader: interactive mobile and assistive-technology testing not completed. Internal editorial judgment, not independent expert certification.
